title: Here's How To Speedrun Losing Custody Of Your Kids
description:
On October 31st, 2021. A 911 call was placed for a highly intoxicated woman who had been drinking & driving with her kids in the car.  When police arrived, they found out that the mom was asking other people for a party to go to & when they said there was no party, she got angry and kicked their car. She was doing all this with her kids in the car. This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
